messages:
maya: Draft runbook for internal vulnerability triage & patch prioritization uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/vuln-triage-draft — please review. TL;DR: intake -> assign owner -> severity + context -> patch window -> deploy & verify -> audit + postmortem. Looking for feedback on KMS/RBAC steps and escalation matrix. Target: finalize by EOD.

arjun: Quick Q — do we treat KMS key rotation as part of the deploy ticket or a separate security ticket? @maya

maya: If key material is directly affected (exposed/compromised) we rotate before deploy and block release until rotation + verification are done. Otherwise mark as post-deploy audit step. I'll add guidance.

jess: +1. Also add an explicit RBAC change log step (who changed roles, why, and rollback). We had a near-miss with role creep last quarter.

claire: Can we add a short escalation matrix? My suggestion: Severity >= HIGH with known exploit -> page CIRT + oncall infra immediately. If data exposure suspected -> page legal and compliance.

sam: Tiny nit: make severity labels consistent with oncall (INFO/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL). Add note about automated dependency updates (dependabot/patch-management).

security-bot: AUTO: New CVE intake submitted: CVE-2024-9999 — preliminary CVSS: 7.8. Reporter: github-dep-scan. Link: https://redwood.internal/cves/2024-9999

maya: Thanks — I'll fold that into the example run. Pasting the triage checklist I'm proposing below for quick comments: 

```
Triage checklist:
- Intake ID and reporter
- Affected services / components
- Initial CVSS score + contextual modifiers
- Proof-of-concept / exploitability (Y/N)
- Assign owner (sec-triage + product/infra owner)
- Blocker? (Y/N) -> if Y, set patch window = immediate
- Patch window: immediate / 24h / next release / scheduled
- KMS rotate required? (Y/N) -> if Y, include rotation runbook + audit
- RBAC change required? (Y/N) -> if Y, record roles and approver + rollback plan
- Audit log entry created (platform-ops ownership)
- Deploy plan (canary %, rollback plan, monitoring signals)
- Post-deploy verification checklist (smoke tests + forensic logs)
- Postmortem + customer/registry disclosure timeline
```

arjun: Who owns the "Audit log entry created" task? I'd nominate platform-ops (platform-ops has the logging hooks).

maya: Owner mapping (draft in doc): platform-ops -> audit + RBAC changes; infra-engineering -> deploy + canary rollouts; sec-triage -> CVE intake, severity decision, escalation; product/security-eng -> impact analysis; legal -> data exposure counsel / disclosures. I'll formalize into a table.

jess: Escalation path proposal: page oncall infra -> if no ack in 15 minutes escalate to eng-sre lead -> if still unresolved escalate to CISO. For confirmed exploit in wild, auto-page CIRT immediately.

claire: Can we include quick commands to collect KMS and key-binding state for triage? Example: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/KEYRING/cryptoKeys/KEY` and `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id KEY_ID`. Also add logs to collect: `journalctl -u redwood-service`, `kubectl describe pod <pod>` and `kubectl logs -l app=service --since=1h`.

maya: Great — I'll add those snippets plus a sample evidence zip checklist. Also adding a short sample message for external disclosure owners to use when engaging vendors/customers.

sam: LGTM. I'll volunteer to own the first dry-run with the oncall rotation next Tuesday to validate timings and SLAs.

security-bot: AUTO: Document updated: /docs/vuln-triage-draft (version 0.2) by maya at 1719501625.

maya: Thanks everyone — action items: I'll update doc with KMS/RBAC/commands/escalation by EOD, sam will run dry-run next Tue, jess/claire please confirm the escalation windows. Tagging @security and @eng-sre for final review. :thumbsup:
